name: Iron Sequencer
look: a seated robot Mew of pink metal with lens-dome eyes, crystal ears, an open chest bay, needle-bristling hands, glowing legs, a fluid-filled tube tail and a long glowing gene-sequencer gun
entry: A Pokémon resembling Mew, described in a lab notebook about a machine that read the genes of every Pokémon it met. It keeps samples in its chest and fires its sequencer to copy any move it has seen.
